scope:
Owned-process crash/canary drill using real Go binaries and disposable roots.

The client emulates only the typed Electron prompt channel. No GUI automation,
live network request, Decred operation, public testnet, or real user profile is
used. No private prompt bytes or secret diagnostics are written to reports.

checks.name: Actual core SIGKILL at password; restart preserves root/confirmation boundaries
Actual core SIGKILL at recording; restart preserves root/confirmation boundaries
Actual core SIGKILL at challenge; restart preserves root/confirmation boundaries
Actual signer SIGKILL revokes the pending prompt and preserves encrypted root
Actual signer SIGABRT revokes the pending prompt and preserves encrypted root
Cancellation and failed reauthentication preserve pending state without secret error details
Password/phrase/fragments/entropy/seed/Ed25519 canaries absent from tested public IPC, logs, argv/env and persisted crash/temp files

notRun: Electron/Chromium crash collection and browser storage/clipboard/QR/network capture
Decred-specific work and public testnet tests excluded by owner
promptException: Only exact active signer-authored prompt and its one-use input reply
